description: A shell script for collecting system metrics, including system info, memory, CPU, and network interface MAC addresses, and logging them to a YAML file.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Sets the log file path based on a suffix and removes existing log file.

methods.name: getEthMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the Ethernet interface, depending on device type.

methods.name: getCpuModel
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU model name from /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: populateSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs system information such as image name, MAC address, date, hostname, release, machine, uptime, gcc version, and openssl version.

methods.name: populateSysMemInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs memory-related information from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: populateSysCPUInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs CPU-related information from /proc/stat.

methods.name: calc_bogo_ops
methods.description: Calculates and logs benchmark operations per second based on input parameters.
